<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>FII outflows and market sentiment:</strong> Indian indices remain under pressure as persistent FII selling, totaling ₹9,980 crore, offsets gains in sectors like IT, while BSE shares dropped nearly 4% following a ₹2,186 crore stake sale by Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Primary market activity:</strong> Inox Clean Energy has filed draft papers with SEBI for a ₹10,000 crore IPO, while recent listings saw mixed results, with Swastika Infra hitting the upper circuit following a strong debut.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Interest rate and bond yield dynamics:</strong> Indian bond yields have eased as global Fed rate hike bets decline, though markets remain cautious due to 30-year US Treasury yields hitting 2002 levels and ongoing U.S.-Iran geopolitical tensions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and monetary policy:</strong> The rupee remains under pressure, trading near 95.97 against the dollar, while analysts anticipate potential RBI repo rate hikes of up to 100 bps through H1 2027 to manage inflation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
</ul>
